input_contract.subject: A workshared Revit document and its user worksets/elements.
required_governance_inputs: classification of link and datum/reference worksets
preconditions: The document is readable through an approved Revit API execution context.

steps: Enumerate user worksets and record names and identifiers.
Resolve each governed workset to its purpose/classification where possible.
Enumerate linked model instances and verify their workset assignment.
Enumerate datum/reference content and physical modeled geometry assigned to datum/reference-only worksets.
Identify personal or uncontrolled production worksets using the governed strategy rather than source example names.
Record positive violations and unresolved classifications and map them to ATS result states.
execution_contract.safety_boundary: Read-only. The checker shall not move elements between worksets, create/delete worksets, or synchronize the model.
execution_contract.authority_boundary: The ETS verifies workset containment and naming evidence only; it does not redefine the project workset strategy.

retained_artifacts: workset and element assignment finding inventory

result_mapping.pass: The model is workshared, all applicable worksets conform to complete governed naming/containment rules, links are correctly assigned, and no physical modeled geometry is found on datum/reference-only worksets.
result_mapping.fail: At least one positive violation is found against an available governed workset rule.
result_mapping.not_applicable: The model is not workshared and no governed workset rule applies.
result_mapping.indeterminate: The project workset strategy or workset-purpose classification required to evaluate one or more findings is incomplete or unavailable.

provenance.migration_note: Appendix E Revit/ZEN ETS contract. Source example workset names remain noncanonical.
